annotations.title: List the games in a franchise

description: Return the games in one franchise or series, such as every Call of Duty, with each one's lowest listed price per platform: grouped by sub-series, newest release first, each game's editions after it. Use it for questions about a whole series; for one publisher's catalogue use get_publisher_games, and for one game's store offers get_game_offers. `name` must be the franchise's exact name, as search_games lists it under franchises (Assassin's Creed), and an unknown name returns an error result. `limit` returns 1-100 games (default 24); `total` is the franchise's full size, which can exceed it. Links go through getcheapgames.com and carry the stores' partner tracking; listed prices exclude the service fee marketplaces add at checkout.

country.description: Two-letter market code, any case, e.g. de, gb, us, br or pl (40 markets). It decides the currency prices come back in, which keys count as region-locked, and the market every link opens in. Omitted or unsupported codes fall back to ie (Ireland, euro).

name.description: The franchise's exact name, e.g. "Grand Theft Auto" or "Assassin's Creed": a `franchises` name from a search result.

name: get_franchise_games

buyUrl.description: Redirect through getcheapgames.com to the cheapest in-stock key.

pricesByPlatform.description: Lowest price per platform, e.g. {"PC": "19.99 EUR"}.

slug.description: The game's id, for its offers.

thirtyDayLow.description: A decimal amount such as 19.99, in the game's `currency`.
